v071UpscaleNote.scope: 10 first-use display regions derived from all six supplied PNGs; originals and original links retained.
v071UpscaleNote.method: 1x crops plus deterministic Lanczos3 2x/4x resampling with mild edge sharpening and lossless WebP. Responsive width descriptors and ResizeObserver slot sizes select assets by placement and device pixel ratio.
v071UpscaleNote.trial: One built-in image_gen comparison candidate was visually reviewed and rejected because shading and icon rendering differed from the documentary screenshot; it is not referenced by the game. No generative candidate shipped.
